item.title: France to ban social media for under-15s by September, Macron announces
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron has ordered fast-tracked legislation to prohibit children under 15 from using social media platforms, joining a growing international movement to restrict youth access to digital networks.

item.title: Monte-Carlo casinos named Best Overall Casino at European Casino Awards
item.description: Monte-Carlo’s two flagship casinos have taken home one of the top honours at this year’s European Casino Awards.

item.title: Prince Albert and family lead Saint Dévote boat burning ritual at Port Hercule
item.description: The Princely Family joined hundreds of residents and visitors at Port Hercule on Monday 26th January for the traditional boat burning ceremony honouring Saint Dévote, Monaco's patron saint.

item.title: Monaco celebrates Saint Dévote with Pontifical Mass and traditional procession
item.description: Prince Albert II and Princess Charlène attended a pontifical mass at Monaco Cathedral on Tuesday January 27th for the celebrations of Saint Dévote.

item.title: India and EU conclude historic free trade agreement after two decades of negotiations
item.description: The "mother of all deals" creates a market of two billion people and eliminates tariffs on 97% of European exports, with both sides seeking to reduce dependence on the US and China.

item.title: Podcast: UBS’s Paul Donovan on 2026 outlook and the $80 trillion wealth transfer
item.description: UBS Chief Economist Paul Donovan unpacks global shifts in wealth, Europe's innovation gap, the future of crypto, and how AI and demographics are set to shape the economy by 2026.

item.title: 253 crews to tackle Alpine stages in Monte Carlo Historic Rally
item.description: Over 250 vintage car enthusiasts from 28 nations will navigate some of Europe's most challenging mountain passes when the Monte Carlo Historic Rally begins on Thursday.

item.title: Medieval warriors to battle it out in free event at Monaco’s big top
item.description: Armoured warriors will descend on Monaco next week to offer a unique spectacle of medieval combat at the Chapiteau de Fontvieille.

item.title: Monaco’s strategic Davos programme draws 500 participants to Monaco Day
item.description: The Principality's three-day presence at the World Economic Forum featured private investor dinners, bilateral meetings with Bahrain, and a Monaco House that hosted 30 speakers.

item.title: Football: Tense draw seals Monaco’s Champions League qualification
item.description: AS Monaco were held to a 0-0 draw by Juventus on Wednesday, but it was sufficient for the Principality club to qualify for the Champions League playoffs.
